name: Seo-Promt-Master
description: Open-source SEO & GEO audit: a zero-dependency CLI (npx), an agent skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini & Copilot, 47 SEO prompts and a cited Google/Bing/AI-search knowledge base. Checks robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, hreflang, structured data, Core Web Vitals and AI crawlers — then fixes them.

analysis.summary_en: Install it into your project, and every coding agent you use — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot — gains an SEO + GEO auditor.
highlights: 2.1.0 — every engine, not just Google: a per-crawler robots.txt matrix for 24 crawlers, a GEO Score, and 47 prompts.
2.2.0 — every doc re-checked against Google's, Bing's and the AI operators' own pages; a sitemap ramp-up for new sites; robots.txt 429 treated as the server error Google treats it as; 30 cr…
Soft 404s, template by template — a route that answers 200 for URLs that don't exist.
